patterns.note: Full-bleed, edge-to-edge imagery and video are used for hero sections and major content blocks, creating an immersive visual experience.
Monumental, condensed, sans-serif typography is used for key headlines, often animating into view and dominating the screen.
A high-contrast palette of deep dark tones (almost black) and crisp white text is consistently punctuated by a vibrant, energetic orange for accents and calls to action.

Large typographic elements animate into view with a fade-up or slide-up effect as their respective sections scroll into the viewport. The initial hero image/video exhibits a subtle parallax or scaling effect on scroll.
A sticky navigation bar appears after initial scroll, transitioning from transparent overlaying the hero to a solid white bar with a subtle shadow.
Sections frequently feature dark backgrounds with white text, creating a dramatic and premium feel, often showcasing vehicles in cinematic settings.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video or high-resolution image with a subtle parallax effect, where the background moves at a slightly different rate than the foreground content on scroll. Text overlays are used for initial messaging.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely using a library like locomotive-scroll or GSAP ScrollTrigger, are employed to reveal large, impactful text headlines. These headlines appear to slide or fade up from the bottom as their sections enter the viewport, creating a dynamic content reveal.

A sticky header is implemented that initially overlays the hero content transparently. Upon scrolling past the hero, it transforms into a solid white bar with a subtle drop shadow, maintaining navigation visibility throughout the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, condensed, bold display headings (~6-8x body size) create dramatic impact, complemented by clean, legible body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used across all elements, from buttons to image frames, reinforcing a modern and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in hero and large typographic sections emphasizes grandeur and visual breathing room, while content grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: This site stands out by leveraging cinematic full-bleed visuals and monumental, scroll-triggered typography to create an immersive, dramatic brand narrative rather than a typical product showcase. The bold orange call to action serves as a powerful, unmissable anchor.
